# We'll search for each contact by email and add the exact match

    {'first_name': 'Andrew', 'last_name': 'Brown', 'email': 'andrew_brow@gmail.com'},
    {'first_name': 'Chelsea', 'last_name': 'Burch', 'email': 'chelsea-burch@gmail.com'},
    {'first_name': 'Eric', 'last_name': 'Bailey', 'email': 'eric.bailey@gmail.com'},

    {'first_name': 'William', 'last_name': 'Martinez', 'email': 'william_mart@gmail.com'}
]

    # Search for the user by email
